parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.id_in_client AS sku,
    sm.id_in_marketplace AS mlb,
    sm.is_catalog,
    sm.status_in_marketplace,
    s.id_product,
    s.id AS sku_id
FROM anymarket_prd.sku_marketplace AS sm
LEFT JOIN anymarket_prd.sku AS s ON s.id = sm.id_sku
WHERE sm.market_place = 'MERCADO_LIVRE'
  AND sm.id_in_marketplace IS NOT NULL
  AND s.oi = {{ $json.oiSql }}
  AND s.id_in_client IN ({{ $json.skusInClause }})
ORDER BY s.id_in_client, sm.is_catalog DESC;
